The '''Briston system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Briston]].
